# 100 Dials

> AI cold-call training for SDR teams. Reps dial a realistic AI prospect built from their own targets at three levels of difficulty; every call ends with the prospect's decision and a transcript, and a scored coach's review is one click away. Managers see skills by rep, the objections the team mishandles, a team leaderboard and a Monday digest.

## Pages

- [Homepage](/): what it does, how it works, the three levels
- [For sales managers](/for-managers): ramp, visibility, team stats, momentum
- [For sales enablement](/for-enablement): grounding in real transcripts, one rubric, measurement
- [Pricing](/pricing): per-seat plans and the free trial
- [Trust and security](/trust): data handling, retention, deletion
- [Blog](/blog): research-backed guides on cold calling

## Facts

- Free trial: 10 calls over 14 days, work email required, no card.
- Scoring rubric: opener, reason for call, discovery, objection handling, value proposition, close.
- Objection taxonomy: sixteen types tagged on every reviewed call with how the rep handled them.
- Customer data is never used to train models.
